sources.title: W3C WAI WCAG 2.1 Technique H63: Using the scope attribute to associate header cells with data cells in data tables
sources.takeaway: Sufficient technique for WCAG 2.1 SC 1.3.1: every `<th>` header cell in data tables should carry a valid `scope` attribute (`scope="col"` on all 273 column headers across 96 tables).

sources.title: W3C WAI Web Accessibility Tutorials: Tables with One Header
